none: PAS NLM-12E791: Roman Coin: Nummus of Constantine II from near Market Rasen
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus of Constantine II (317-340), imperial titles reverse issue of 326 from Trier mint, Reece period 16; LRBC page 4 no. 20. Obverse description: Youthful bust laureate draped or mantled left. No legend. Reverse description: Eight pointed star over legend. Reverse inscription: CONSTAN / TINVS / CAESAR. In exergue: TRP. This coin was kindly identified by Cliff Reeves.…
